mapper.select: SELECT MENU_SEQ , MENU_ID , MENU_NM , MENU_NM_ENG , MENU_DESC , MENU_ICON , PARENT_ID , SORT_ORDER , URL , USE_FLAG , POPUP_FLAG FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE MENU_SEQ = #{in_menuSeq}
SELECT MENU_SEQ AS VALUE ,MENU_NM AS CODE FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE 1=1 AND PARENT_ID IS NULL ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER)

SELECT USER_ID ,ROLE FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE 1=1
AND ROLE IN #{item}

SELECT * FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE 1=1
AND menu_id = #{in_menuId} OR menu_seq = #{in_menuSeq}

SELECT MENU_SEQ , PARENT_ID , SORT_ORDER FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE 1=1
AND PARENT_ID IS NULL
AND PARENT_ID = #{in_parentId}
AND SORT_ORDER !=#{in_oldOrder} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER

/*selectMenuAccessUsers*/ SELECT CASE WHEN USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE WHERE MENU_SEQ = #{in_menuSeq}) THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS pageAccess, ROLE, USER_ID, USER_ID || ' (' || USER_NM || ')' AS USER_NM FROM TB_M_USERINFO ORDER BY USER_ID

SELECT '1' AS pageAccess, ROLE, USER_ID, USER_ID || ' (' || USER_NM || ')' AS USER_NM FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID NOT IN(SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE WHERE MENU_SEQ = #{in_menuSeq}) UNION ALL SELECT '2' AS pageAccess, ROLE, USER_ID, USER_ID || ' (' || USER_NM || ')' AS USER_NM FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID IN(SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE WHERE MENU_SEQ = #{in_menuSeq}) ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE 1=1 AND PARENT_ID = #{in_menuSeq} AND USE_FLAG = 'Y'
SELECT ROLE AS role, USER_ID AS user_id, USER_NM AS user_nm FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY USER_NM
SELECT MENU_SEQ, PARENT_ID, MENU_NM, USE_FLAG, SORT_ORDER FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(PARENT_ID, MENU_SEQ), SORT_ORDER, MENU_SEQ
